chunks: And whatever is narrated from Salamah ibn Tammam, the companion of Amir Al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him,

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir Al-Mu'minin (Commander of the Faithful), a title for Imam Ali
key_terms.سَلَمَةَ بْنِ تَمَّامٍ: Salamah ibn Tammam, a companion of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: Who is the source of the narration regarding Salamah ibn Tammam in this hadith?
ai.summary: This introductory clause in *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih* explicitly anchors the subsequent narration to Salamah ibn Tammam, a prominent companion of Imam Ali (AS) known for his reliability and close association with the Imam. By citing him directly, Shaykh al-Saduq emphasizes the authenticity of the chain (isnad) and highlights the direct link to the era of the first Imam, reinforcing the jurisprudential weight of the transmitted knowledge within the Shia scholarly tradition.
